verses.text: Think about it this way. While an heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, even though he owns everything.
He is under guardians and managers until the time his father has set.
It was the same for us. When we were children, we were slaves to the basic powers of this world.
But when the right time came, God sent his Son. He was born of a woman and born under the law.
He came to set free those under the law, so that we could be adopted as God's children.
Because you are his children, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. The Spirit calls out, "Abba, Father!"
So you are no longer a slave, but a child. And if you are his child, God has also made you an heir through Christ.
In the past you did not know God. You were slaves to things that are not really gods.
But now you know God, or rather, God knows you. So why do you turn back to those weak and worthless basic powers? Do you want to be their slaves all over again?
You keep special days, months, seasons and years!
I am afraid for you. Maybe all my hard work for you was wasted.
Brothers and sisters, I beg you, become like me, for I became like you. You did me no wrong.
You know that I first preached the Good News to you because I was ill.
My illness was a trial to you, but you did not look down on me or turn me away. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, or even Christ Jesus himself.
What happened to your joy? I can tell you, if you could have, you would have torn out your own eyes and given them to me.
So have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
Those people are very keen to win you over, but not for good. They want to cut you off from us, so that you will be keen on them.
It is always good to be keen for a good purpose, and not only when I am with you.
My dear children, I am again in pain for you, like a woman giving birth, until Christ is formed in you.
I wish I could be with you now and speak in a different way, because I am very worried about you.
Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not listen to what the law says?
It is written that Abraham had two sons. One was by the slave woman, and the other by the free woman.
The son of the slave woman was born in the normal human way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
These things are a picture. The two women stand for two agreements. One agreement is from Mount Sinai, and its children are born to be slaves. This is Hagar.
Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia. She is like the Jerusalem of today, because she and her children are slaves.
But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
It is written, "Be glad, woman who could not have children. Shout for joy, you who never felt the pain of giving birth. The lonely woman will have more children than the woman who has a husband."
Now you, brothers and sisters, are children of the promise, just like Isaac.
At that time, the son born in the normal human way attacked the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.
But what do the Scriptures say? "Send away the slave woman and her son. The slave woman's son will never share the inheritance with the free woman's son."
So, brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
